StreamMate 0.11.0 (463439)

- Keeps verified portrait art on Home, Movies and Shows during guide refresh. A conflicting edition can show a title placeholder until its portrait arrives.
- Opens Welcome on a first launch after an upgrade when setup has not started. Empty Home offers Finish setup if setup was already marked complete.
- Slows the Welcome and All Set shimmer and respects reduced motion.
- The default phone menu is Home, Live TV, Shows, Movies, Sports and More. Existing custom layouts are preserved.

Tested on phone and TV emulators with synthetic guide data.
